title: 第十九章 你想死么第二十章 修仙之途和
content_zh:
就在李言开始沉入水潭之时，岸边季军师木然的神情忽有一丝松动。
“坚持到吸收十之七八的药力，和上次那名弟子相同。
但如果是这样，以他杂灵根的资质，能否炼化药力到达凝气一层已是更难了，不管如何，且还需一试才知，但愿不要像上次一样的结果。”
当下他也不再多想，双脚一蹬地面，身形便跃空而起，双臂平行舒展，大袖迎风鼓涨中，犹如一头黑鹏向水潭的水面掠去。
在接近水面的一刹那，一手袖袍向那些兀自还在水面盘旋、吞吐不定的黑气一抖，在一片“波波波”声中，十股黑气已溃成一缕缕细小黑烟四处散开了去。
继而他身形在空中一个俯冲，另一只手自大袖中一探而出，下一刻便抓向了水面下的李言，只听“哗”的一声，李言已被他当胸抓住拖出了水面。
然后他脚尖在水面上轻轻一点，继而身形在空中又是一折，已带着李言向岸边飞去。
这时昏迷中的李言在他手上晃若无甚重量，季军师身形如一缕轻烟已飘到了岸上，这几下动作兔起鹘落，轻灵迅速。
而他未发现的是，就在他左手一拂那些水面黑气之时，平日里藏于袖中，时时紧握的那本怪书随这一拂之力，却有一丝金色的光芒破书而出。
然后就混杂在了水面上那些溃散的黑烟之中，它穿过黑烟又以极快的速度迎向被他抓起的李言身体之上，一闪即没，当下无影无踪。
季军师先前几点青芒刚入体内之时，李言灵台顿时有了几分清明，这几十日的苦练，已让他形成本能。
“这就奇了，人未死，却是无法醒转，上次时只是一次灵气入体，便让其醒转了过来，这次却是为何这般了？”
李言听得此言，再看老者的样子，虽然依旧一头雾水，但也不再追问，静静地站在那里，等待老者的下文。
当下他站直身形，以手抚额，思索起来。
而此刻的李言，体内已是火毒纵横肆虐，所过之处，经脉已被破坏殆尽。
“我知道你有很多问题，但我时间不多，只能将重要的事情说与你知，待得你以后若有机缘拜入一处仙门，便会慢慢知晓。”
自远古时期便有仙人存在的，盘古开天辟地、女娲补天之后，天地便被分成数个层面，凡人界、仙灵界、真仙界。
“使者大人何出此言？我刚才还在青山隘的山谷之内，突然之间就来到了此地，不是魂魄被勾，那还能是什么？”
灰衫老者缓缓走到李言的身前，眼睛盯着他，一股森冷接气机弥漫而出。
但天地自有法则，给了你悠长的寿命，就会带给你其他的限制，这些洪荒的后裔们却繁衍困难，无论是人类，还是妖兽或其它种族都生育极难，种族数量都比较稀少。

识海李言倒未曾听说过，但“意识”这些他还是听懂一些的，在他修炼时，就是通过冥想驱使意识来完成的，所以这也是武林中常称的意念。
最高一层则是真仙界，这里已是传说中真正的仙界，像远古的盘古、女娲他们都是至高无上的仙人，就居住在此界。
说完后，他更是一惊，自己何时可以开口说话了，刚才不是无法言语的吗？想来是自己的魂魄已离体了，现在说话的是自己的魂魄无疑了。
而下面仙灵界许多修仙者，当修炼达大乘境界后，就可以尝试破碎两界，虚空飞升上到真仙界的。
就在李言不知发生何事时，灰衫老者已是隔空一指便点在了他的额头之上。
老者听得此言，先是一愣，清矍的脸上却露出一丝笑容。
李言心中苦笑一声。
“这里便是书中佛家常说的阿鼻地狱了吗？下面应该是地狱的修罗海吧，那眼前这老者便应那是勾魂使者了，不过看起来至少却不让人害怕。”
老者微笑着说道。
最后，慢慢形成了一个模糊的人影，人影刚一形成就慢慢向他走来，随着那人的临近，身影也渐渐清晰起来。
这一界天地灵气充沛，无论是人类还是其他生灵都寿命悠长，他们先祖传下很多古老的仙法，通过修行这些仙法，便可具有飞天入地、翻江倒海。
content_en:
Just when Li Yan began to sink into the pool, the dull expression on the shore of the third army master suddenly relaxed a little.
"Persevere until you absorb seventy-eight percent of the medicinal power, which is the same as the disciple last time.
But if this is the case, with his qualifications of mixed spiritual roots, it is already more difficult to refine the medicinal power to reach the level of Qi Condensation. No matter what, it will take a try to find out. I hope it won't be the same as last time. "
At the moment, he no longer thought about it. He pushed off the ground with his feet and jumped into the air. His arms were stretched out in parallel, and his big sleeves were swelling in the wind, like a black roc flying towards the surface of the pool.
The moment he approached the water, he shook his sleeves at the black air that was still hovering and hesitating on the water. Amidst the sound of "waves", ten strands of black air collapsed into wisps of fine black smoke and dispersed in all directions.
Then he dived in the air, and his other hand came out of his sleeve. The next moment, he grabbed Li Yan under the water. With a "swish" sound, Li Yan was grabbed by his chest and dragged out of the water.
Then he tapped his toes lightly on the water, then his body turned again in the air, and he flew towards the shore with Li Yan.
At this time, Li Yan, who was in a coma, was dangling in his hand as if he had no weight at all. The figure of Master Ji was like a wisp of smoke floating on the shore. His movements were swift and agile.
What he didn't realize was that when he brushed the black air on the water with his left hand, a trace of golden light burst out of the strange book that he usually kept tightly in his sleeve with the force of the brush.
Then it got mixed into the disintegrating black smoke on the water. It passed through the black smoke and headed towards the body of Li Yan who was caught by him at an extremely fast speed. It disappeared in a flash and disappeared without a trace.
When Ji Junshi's green light had just entered his body earlier, Li Yanlingtai suddenly became a little clearer. These decades of hard training have made him develop instincts.
"This is strange. People are not dead, but they can't wake up. Last time, it was just a spiritual energy entering the body that made them wake up. Why is it like this this time?"
Li Yan heard this and looked at the old man's appearance. Although he was still confused, he stopped asking and stood there quietly, waiting for the old man's next words.
At that moment, he stood up straight, put his hand on his forehead, and began to think.
At this moment, Li Yan's body was already filled with fire and poison, and wherever it passed, the meridians had been completely destroyed.
"I know you have many questions, but I don't have much time. I can only tell you the important things. If you have the opportunity to enter a fairy gate in the future, you will gradually know."
Immortals have existed since ancient times. After Pangu created the world and Nuwa mended the sky, the world was divided into several levels: the mortal world, the fairy world, and the true fairy world.
"Why did the messenger say this? I was in the valley of Qingshan Pass just now, and suddenly I came here. If my soul is not hooked, what else could it be?"
The old man in gray shirt walked slowly in front of Li Yan, staring at him, and a cold breath filled the air.
But the laws of heaven and earth have their own laws. If they give you a long lifespan, they will bring you other restrictions. However, these descendants of the ancient world have difficulty in reproducing. It is extremely difficult for humans, monsters, or other races to reproduce, and the number of races is relatively rare.
Li Yan had never heard of Consciousness Sea, but he still understood something about "consciousness". When he was practicing, he used meditation to drive consciousness, so this is also what is often called an idea in the martial arts world.
The highest level is the True Immortal Realm, which is already the legendary real Immortal Realm. Ancient Pangu and Nuwa were all supreme immortals and lived in this realm.
After he finished speaking, he was even more surprised. When could he speak? Wasn't he unable to speak just now? It seems that his soul has left his body, so it is undoubtedly his soul that is speaking now.
Many cultivators in the fairy world below, after reaching the Mahayana realm, can try to break the two realms and ascend to the true fairy world in the void.Just when Li Yan didn't know what was going on, the old man in gray shirt had already tapped his forehead with a finger from afar.
When the old man heard this, he was stunned for a moment, but then a smile appeared on his slender face.
Li Yan smiled bitterly in his heart.
"Is this the Abi Hell that Buddhists often talk about in books? It should be the Shura Sea of Hell below, and the old man in front of me should be the Soul Seducer, but at least it doesn't look scary."
The old man said with a smile.
Finally, a blurry figure slowly formed. As soon as the figure was formed, it slowly walked towards him. As the person approached, the figure gradually became clearer.
This world is full of spiritual energy, and both humans and other creatures have long lifespans. Their ancestors passed down many ancient immortal methods. By practicing these immortal methods, one can fly into the sky and the earth, and turn over rivers and seas.
